We are happy to announce a Master's internship position (with the possibility of a Ph.D. follow-up) opening in 2027 at Sorbonne University (LIP6). The internship will focus on Topological Data Analysis for Dimensionality Reduction. It will be co-advised by Mathieu Carrière (INRIA) and Julien Tierny (CNRS).

More details are available here:

Thank you for forwarding this offer to any colleagues or students who may be interested.

Please feel free to contact us directly by email for more information.
